title: Background music, round 2: full pieces for each part of the day and the island
context: This is background music for the game, the second round of new tracks. You rejected all 28 pieces in music-round-3 as far below the original title melody, so the local music model is out.

These pieces come from Lyria 3 Pro, the newer version of the Google model that made the game's current tracks (the calm, lively, office and night loops). Lyria 2 only makes 30-second clips. Lyria 3 Pro writes a whole piece of about two and a half minutes. I asked each piece for the melody, a variation on a second instrument, a quieter interlude, a counter-melody, and the melody again with everyone playing.

There are seven uses with two candidates each. The card names start with the use: title, morning (outdoors during the day), evening, night (the dorms), office, shops (the shop street) and harbour. Each note says where the piece would play and what plays there today.

Each card is the part of the piece the game would loop, between 1:48 and 2:30 long. Today's loops are about 30 seconds. After the loop the card plays the first 15 seconds of the repeat, so you can hear the loop point, and then it fades out. In the game it would keep going.

I can't listen to audio myself, so I checked the pieces by measurement. I made 43 pieces and kept the two per use that passed best: no singing (any voice is separated out and measured), nothing that scores as noise, cheap or out-of-tune sound, and a loop point where the music matches and the beat keeps going. The other 29 stay on this machine. Three cards have a note about their loop point.

Nothing here is in the game. Pick one piece for each use, or reject both for a use. Your picks replace the current loops in those places, and uses with no pick get another round. If the style is wrong as a whole, say so in the overall comment.
ask: Pick one piece for each use you like (for example title-4, office-1), and reject both for a use where neither fits.

options.note: Title menu. Plays on the title menu, before you start or load a game. Today the title plays the calm train loop. Loops every 1:48: the game plays the piece from 0:40 to 2:28 of the original 2:42 and then goes back. The card plays that once, then the first 15 seconds of the repeat. Lyria 3 Pro, seed 5712. Prompt: "Instrumental background music for a cozy Japanese slice-of-life anime game. Warm, melodic, full-bodied anime soundtrack with a memorable lead melody and rich chords, polished studio recording. No vocals, no singing, no choir, no humming. This is the title menu theme: hopeful, gentle, sweeping, a new start on an island at sunrise. Instruments: piano, string section, soft synth pad, light harp. D major, 84 BPM, 4/4, one steady tempo and key throughout. Structure: [0:00 - 0:30] the main melody, played simply on the piano, the ensemble soft underneath. [0:30 - 1:00] the violins take the same melody, fuller accompaniment. [1:00 - 1:30] a calmer interlude: sparse piano, the melody in fragments over new chords. [1:30 - 2:00] a counter-melody on the cello over the main chords. [2:00 - 2:40] the main melody returns with the whole ensemble, then eases back to the opening texture with no fade-out and no final ending chord, so the piece can loop." Measured: vocal stem -24.1 dB of the mix (today's Lyria loops: about -32; a sung track: about -12), loop-point match 0.448 (0.1 means the music repeats itself, 0.9 unrelated passages).
